Overview

Huntsville is a city in AL with a population of 215,006. Rocket City with NASA, defense contractors, and the highest concentration of PhDs in America. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
